summary: Your thirteenth Sunday review, at the three-month mark. You answer 10 questions across the course with a confidence number, count your real days, hours and commits, write what worked and what to reset, check the portfolio as a stranger would, start everything from cold, tag month-3 and plan week 14.
goal: Review the first three months: what worked, what to reset.

items.text: Self-test: answer the 10 questions with a 1 to 3 confidence number, then mark each one
Count the three months: days ticked, hours, weeks kept, commits
Write what worked and what to reset, and make one reset small enough to start tomorrow
Check the portfolio list as a stranger and fix the cheapest item
Run it from cold: database, Python service, gateway, one ask and one assist
Run git tag month-3, then plan week 14 with one outcome sentence and a drop list
Play the Month 3 Mix-up game to the end and see your score
